youtube.title: Carrying Guilt Into Christmas? Christmas Eve Prayer | Matthew 1:21 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. It's Christmas Eve. Here's why the name matters.

"And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins." Matthew 1:21 (KJV)

His name tells you what he came to do. He came to save.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.
